name: Giancarlo Bodoni Turtle to Back System
description: Giancarlo Bodoni’s Chest To Back - Behind The Elbows covers turtle breakdowns, hook insertion, four-point positions and rear-mount offense.
summary: Breaking down turtle, inserting hooks and following defensive movement into back offense.
overview: Essential Connections: Chest To Back - Behind The Elbows covers the work between getting behind an opponent and establishing rear mount. Giancarlo Bodoni addresses open and closed turtle, four-point positions, stand-ups and defensive rolls before developing rear-control attacks. That breadth is useful when an opponent keeps moving or rising before you can secure the back.

related_content.name: Danaher Straight Jacket System
related_content.relationship: The straightjacket-focused overview of Back Attacks Enter The System is useful when your main priority is hand fighting and strangles from established back control.

products.title: Essential Connections: Chest To Back - Behind The Elbows
products.blurb: Eight volumes on turtle breakdowns, back-control transitions and rear-mount offense.
products.best_for: Grapplers who reach the rear of turtle but lose control before establishing back attacks.

guide.display_title: Giancarlo Bodoni: Turtle Breakdowns and Back Attacks

fits: You get behind turtle but struggle to establish hooks or keep the opponent down.
You want coverage of stand-ups and rolling defenses as well as back finishing.

includes: Turtle breakdowns, near- and far-hook insertion and body-triangle connections.
Following turtle movement, four-point positions, stand-ups and Granby rolls.
Standing rear-body-lock returns, rear-control hand fighting and strangles.
limits: The focus is offense after getting behind the elbows; it is not a general guard-passing or front-facing takedown course.
